source_limitations: Cambridge publisher-owned search-indexed page excerpts observed 2026-10-28; direct full-page requests returned HTTP 403. Not direct full-page dictionary inspection, not independent bilingual review, and not CEFR teaching approval. Source CEFR is sense-specific where indicated; source labels do not automatically mandate retiering. All eight draft snapshots are unchanged and held.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: People in a community or society in general.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ပြည်သူလူထု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The library is open to the public.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge publisher-indexed entry labels the noun 'the public' B1, while the A2 draft uses exactly this group-of-people sense.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Review A2 suitability; independently select a source-supported A2 sense or replace/retier while maintaining 200 A2 entries.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A set of connected parts that work together.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The new system keeps track of our orders.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge English entry labels interconnected devices/computer equipment B1; Learner's Dictionary distinguishes B2 method-of-doing-things. Draft example about tracking orders may describe software or an organisational method.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent reviewer must identify whether the order-tracking system means equipment/software or an organisational method, then establish a defensible A2 placement or replace/retier.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: To help someone succeed or manage a difficulty.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ကူညီပံ့ပိုးသည်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: My colleagues support me when I need help.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels emotional or practical assistance B1; draft colleagues-helping example targets that help sense, not the B2 encourage-a-cause sense.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Review B1-labelled help sense; do not silently use an unrelated source sense to justify A2.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The ability to control or influence what happens.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The manager has the power to approve requests.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels ability to control people and events B2; the manager's authority to approve requests appears to target control/authority rather than electrical energy.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent reviewer must evaluate manager-authority meaning, Myanmar distinction အာဏာ versus စွမ်းအား, and replacement or retiering.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Used to say what is true, especially when it differs from what someone expected.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: တကယ်တော့၊ အမှန်တကယ်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: I thought it was Tuesday, but it is actually Wednesday.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge distinguishes A2 factual truth from B1 surprising or unexpected correction. Draft contrasts a mistaken Tuesday belief with Wednesday, potentially straddling these uses.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent reviewer should determine whether the draft sentence is merely factual correction or a B1 surprise/discourse function; align Burmese and example.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with what was just said.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The room was small; however, it was comfortable.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels contrastive sentence-linking however A2, distinct from B2 degree however and C2 manner however; draft uses contrastive connector.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent reviewer must still assess punctuation, register, Burmese gloss, and grammar.

shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: တစ်ခုလုံးသော၊ အပြည့်အစုံဖြစ်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: We spent the whole afternoon cleaning the classroom.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge Learner's Dictionary labels complete adjective A2; draft's whole afternoon illustrates complete duration, not B1 noun 'the whole of'.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent reviewer to check Myanmar naturalness and whether the adjective and sentence are consistent.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A smaller amount of something that cannot usually be counted.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Please add less sugar to my tea.

publisher_source.source_observation: Cambridge labels smaller amount determiner/quantifier A2; draft less sugar illustrates an uncountable quantity, not plural-count fewer.

records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent reviewer to check Burmese comparative nuance and grammar distinction less versus fewer.
